cohort: The study included 607,808 birthing people in California with singleton, term live births who had a history of at least one prior cesarean birth and no identified contraindications to a vaginal birth.
finding: VBAC rates increased for most racial/ethnic groups in California between 2011 and 2021, with Hawaiian/Pacific Islander birthing people having the highest average VBAC rate and Black and Hawaiian/Pacific Islander individuals being more likely to have a VBAC compared to white birthing people.
mod_finding: Black and Hawaiian/Pacific Islander birthing people were more likely to have a VBAC compared with white birthing people, while Hispanic birthing people were less likely, and VBAC rates increased for most racial/ethnic groups over time.
